quotes.text: Ephraim was assigned the center of the land, but failed to heed Moses' commandment from the Lord and settled among the Canaanite peoples. This practice became common with each tribe and brought disastrous repercussions as the peoples intermarried and some Israelites turned from the Lord (Josh. 16:10; Lev. 18:1-5, 24-28; Deut. 7:1-5; Judg. 2).
quotes.speaker: Ellis T. Rasmussen
quotes.source: A Latter-day Saint Commentary on the Old Testament
quotes.attr: Ellis T. Rasmussen, A Latter-day Saint Commentary on the Old Testament, 204
